mapper.select: select d.id, d.order_id, d.purchase_detail_id, d.sku_id, sku.item_id, item.item_code, item.item_name, item.supplier_id, merchant.merchant_name as supplier_name, d.return_quantity, d.received_quantity, d.max_quantity, d.remark from wms_return_order_detail d inner join wms_item_sku sku on sku.id = d.sku_id inner join wms_item item on item.id = sku.item_id left join wms_merchant merchant on merchant.id = item.supplier_id where d.order_id = #{orderId} order by d.id
